Class
Description
Admin
Represents a system Administrator.

Console UI for Admin role — full feature coverage including updateUser.
AuthController
Handles authentication: login, logout, and language switching.
CitationFormat
Represents the citation format for a research paper.
Comment
Represents a comment left by a User on a News post.
Course
Represents a university Course.
CourseRegistrationController
Handles all course registration business logic.
CourseType
Represents the type of a Course.
CreditLimitException
Thrown when a student attempts to register for a course that would exceed the 21-credit limit.
DataStore
Singleton in-memory data store for the entire UniversitySystem.
Employee
Abstract class representing any university employee (Teacher, Manager, Admin, TechSupportSpecialist).
GraduateStudent
Represents a graduate (Master or PhD) student.
GraduateStudentBoundary
Console UI for GraduateStudent — extends StudentBoundary, adds grad + researcher features.
Journal
Represents a scientific journal that publishes ResearchPaper objects.
Language
Represents the interface language of the system.
Lesson
Represents a single lesson (lecture, practice, or lab) within a Course.
LessonType
Represents the type of a Lesson.
LoginBoundary
Boundary class for the login screen.
LowHIndexException
Thrown when a researcher's H-Index is below the required minimum for a given action (e.g., supervising a graduate student requires H-Index >= 3).

MainMenuBoundary
Main menu router — directs authenticated users to their role-specific boundary.
Manager
Represents a university Manager (Office of the Registrar, Department Head, Dean).
ManagerBoundary
Console UI for Manager role — full feature coverage.
ManagerType
Represents the type/role of a Manager in the university.
Mark
Represents a student's mark for a specific course.
MarkController
Handles mark assignment and GPA computation.
Message
Represents a direct message sent between two Employee users.
News
Represents a news/announcement post visible to all users of the system.
NewsController
Handles creation, publishing, and pinning of News items.
NewsTopic
Represents the topic category of a News post.
NotResearcherException
Thrown when an operation that requires a Researcher role is attempted by a non-researcher.
Observer
Observer interface — part of the Observer design pattern.
ReportController
Handles generation of system reports for managers and teachers.
RequestStatus
Represents the lifecycle status of a SupportRequest.
ResearchController
Handles all research-related operations: publishing papers, computing H-Index, managing journals and projects.
Researcher
Interface that marks a user as a Researcher.
ResearcherBoundary
 
ResearchPaper
Represents a scientific research paper published by a Researcher.
ResearchPaperCitationComparator
Concrete Strategy: sorts ResearchPapers by citation count (descending — most cited first).
ResearchPaperComparator
Strategy interface for comparing two ResearchPaper objects.
ResearchPaperDateComparator
Concrete Strategy: sorts ResearchPapers by publication date (newest first).
ResearchPaperPagesComparator
Concrete Strategy: sorts ResearchPapers by number of pages (ascending).
ResearchProject
Represents a research project that multiple researchers can join.
School
Represents the school (faculty) a teacher or student belongs to.
Student
Represents a university Student.
StudentBoundary
Console UI for Student role — full feature coverage.
StudentOrganization
Represents a student organisation (club, society, etc.) at the university.
StudentType
Represents the degree level of a Student.
Subject
Subject interface — part of the Observer design pattern.
SupportController
Handles technical support request lifecycle: creation, viewing, accepting, rejecting, and closing.
SupportRequest
Represents a technical support request submitted by a User.
Teacher
Represents a university Teacher.
TeacherBoundary
Console UI for Teacher role — full feature coverage including Researcher functions.
TeacherPosition
Represents the academic position of a Teacher.
TechSupportBoundary
Console UI for TechSupportSpecialist — full lifecycle management.
TechSupportSpecialist
Represents a Technical Support Specialist.
TooManyFailsException
Thrown when a student has failed too many courses and is subject to academic dismissal.
Transcript
Represents a student's official academic transcript.
UrgencyLevel
Represents the urgency level of a complaint or support request.
User
Abstract base class for every user in the UniversitySystem.
UserController
Handles CRUD operations for User objects via the DataStore.
UserFactory
Factory Method pattern implementation.
